# Agenten

> The role builder's Agenten page in the Platform's console, where an administrator registers agents - the Knovas Assistent and external agents - and makes them members of roles.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `L2-PLATFORM-AGENTS` |
| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Level | 2 |
| Parent | `L1-WORKSPACE` |

### Source paths

- `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_agents.py`
- `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_agents.html`

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Aliases | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-AGENTS/R-1` | `L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN/R-6` | Agents (RB-6, RB-7): the page Agenten lists every agent (the Knovas Assistent and the external agents) with whom it acts for, its id (Knovas binds the gateway key to it) and its roles; registers an external agent for an active person or on its own, and revokes one; on a role, adds and removes an agent, the assistant included, never into Administration (the agent rows and «+ Agent hinzufügen» under «Mitglieder» of the Rollen page). After each change is committed it hands that agent's claims to the Core's gateway at once, behind the switch agents.core_gateway; a Core that refuses never breaks the page. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_agents.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_agents.html` |

### Not responsible for

- The console's blueprint and its role gates (L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN); the Rollen page and its routes (L2-PLATFORM-ROLES), which draws the agent rows this card's role_agents gives and whose page the role forms here answer with.
- The agents as stored, their audit rows, an agent's claim and the delivery to the Core's gateway (identity/agents.py, identity/agent_delivery.py, migration 0028_agents); the Platform's identity package, which has no card.
- An agent's gateway key; Knovas issues it, bound to the agent's id. The Platform holds no agent key.

### Terms

- agent (a member of roles that is not a person - the Knovas Assistent, or an external agent registered here)
